name: airwallex-agentos
description: Airwallex AgentOS skills for Codex — billing, payouts, card issuing, and treasury workflows. Works with the airwallex CLI or the Airwallex MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Billing, payouts, card issuing, and treasury workflows powered by Airwallex AgentOS.
interface.longDescription: Agent skills for orchestrating Airwallex financial operations — extract billing details from contracts, create beneficiaries from supplier documents, provision virtual and physical corporate cards, and aggregate multi-currency cashflow summaries. Works with the airwallex CLI or an Airwallex MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Extract billing details from this contract and create an invoice
Create a beneficiary from this supplier document
Provision a virtual card with a $5,000 monthly limit
Show me a cashflow summary across all currencies
